title: Trump presidential transition: Cabinet appointments, White House positions and more
text: “I don’t want to be a part of their trying to rewrite what happened that day,” said Pamela Hemphill, a Jan. 6 defendant who was sentenced to two months in jail for her role in the Capitol riot.
